# Chay Runtime

When this repository contains `chay-memory/` or `.chay/`, follow `chay-memory/rules/chay-runtime.md` before editing code.

Use `chay-structure/features/<feature_id>.md`, `chay-structure/folder_structure.md`, `chay-structure/api_graph.md`, and `chay-memory/feature_graph.json` to determine scope. If the selected files do not match the business goal, ask the user to rerun `cr go "Task" --files path/to/file`.
